title_en: 11oz Coffee Mug, All-Over Print Graffiti Pups Amber Ceramic Cup, Full Wrap Around Design, 5 Interior Colors, Dishwasher & Microwave Safe, Gift for Coffee Lovers
bullets_en: FULL WRAP AROUND PRINT - the artwork runs edge to edge around the whole mug, so the scene continues from every angle with no blank white panel

SEAMLESS ALL-OVER DESIGN - spray-stencilled puppy and kitten faces with dripping paint, paw marks and little stars on, printed in burnt amber, terracotta, cream and a touch of teal with crisp long-lasting detail
5 INTERIOR COLORS - choose White, Black, Pink, Red or Blue interior; glossy white exterior suits every kitchen and desk
PREMIUM 11oz CERAMIC - 11 oz / 330 ml, food-grade glaze, safe for dishwasher and microwave
GIFT-READY - a warm present for coffee lovers, coworkers, teachers and hostesses
description_en:
A full wrap design, not a small front print: street-sprayed pet portraits with runny paint, stencil stars and paw marks over a burnt terracotta field. The artwork circles this 11 oz ceramic mug from handle to handle, so there is no blank side and no white gap. A restrained retro palette keeps it easy to live with on a desk or an open shelf.

Glossy white body with your choice of interior color, a comfortable C-shaped handle, and a print baked for long-lasting color. Dishwasher and microwave safe. Packed securely for safe delivery.

A quiet, illustrated mug for slow mornings, and an easy gift for anyone who likes their coffee with a scene.
